methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $250M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Drones & Autonomous (found 0 same-stage, 0 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 5 same-sector peers exist in Drones & Autonomous, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Rhoman Aerospace is a Seed-stage company operating in the Drones & Autonomous sector alongside five identified private peers including Zipline, Joby Aviation, and Nuro. The public markets offer no direct comparables in this subsector. The valuation universe consists of 6 private companies, though none share Rhoman's exact stage and valuation tier, limiting the applicability of peer-median methods.

Given data constraints, Stage-Progression analysis serves as the primary valuation methodology. Using a $250M total-raised proxy as the base value and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage progressions yields an implied valuation of $625M. This method assumes the base value reasonably approximates Rhoman's current market positioning relative to capital deployment patterns observed in frontier aerospace.

The triangulation analysis, constrained to a single applicable method, supports a valuation range of $531M to $719M, with a median of $625M. The narrow methodological foundation reflects a fundamental data limitation: insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage peers with comparable valuation tiers preclude robust peer-median benchmarking. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the $250M base proxy, the applicability of 2.5x stage multipliers to drone/autonomous subsector norms, and the absence of public market reference points. Resolution of Rhoman's product maturity, customer traction, and competitive positioning relative to the named peer set would materially refine this range.
